Description: "Update customer name placeholder to show asterisk for pre-orders"
Instruction: "Add pre-order mandatory check to customer name input placeholder"
ReplacementContent:
"                           <input
                             type="text"
                             id="customer-name-input"
                             placeholder={
                               ((orderType === 'PICKUP' || orderType === 'DELIVERY') && (
                                 (subOrderType === 'DELIVERY' && getStaffPermissions()?.pos_access?.Delivery?.customer_details_mandatory === true) ||
                                 (subOrderType !== 'DELIVERY' && getStaffPermissions()?.pos_access?.Pickup?.customer_details_mandatory === true)
                               )) || (activeTrayTab === 'PreOrder' && business?.business_details?.settings?.preOrderDetailsMandatory === true)
                                 ? "Customer Name *"
                                 : "Customer Name"
                             }"
